categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Tigermed Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive clinical trial services for new drug development and medical devices. Its main business segments include clinical trial technical services, clinical trial related services, and laboratory services. The company offers end-to-end solutions covering clinical operations, pharmacology, regulatory affairs, scientific affairs, medical translation, pharmacovigilance, real-world research, third-party audits, training, data management, statistical analysis, site management, patient recruitment, medical imaging, and laboratory testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced clinical trial management technologies including digital and decentralized clinical trial (DCT) platforms, risk-based quality management (RBQM) systems, electronic data capture (EDC), electronic source data records (ESR), remote monitoring, and electronic trial master files (eTMF). It integrates digital, intelligent, and remote methodologies to enhance trial efficiency and quality. Laboratory services utilize GLP-certified facilities for chemical, microbiological, toxicological, and bioanalytical testing. The company also develops proprietary digital health and clinical trial platforms to support full lifecycle drug and device development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tigermed serves global pharmaceutical and medical device innovators, including multinational pharmaceutical companies, large domestic drug manufacturers, and emerging biotech firms. Its customers span various therapeutic areas such as oncology, respiratory, infectious diseases, endocrinology, hematology, neurology, cardiovascular, dermatology, immunology, metabolism, and rare diseases. The company supports clinical trials for innovative drugs, generic drugs, vaccines, and medical devices, catering to both domestic Chinese and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with subsidiaries and teams across 28 countries covering Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America. Key operational hubs include China (headquartered in Hangzhou), Hong Kong (international headquarters), the United States, Canada, Europe (including Croatia, Romania, Italy, Germany), South Korea, Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Laos), Australia, and emerging markets in Latin America and Africa. It maintains extensive clinical trial networks and partnerships in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tigermed operates primarily in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical and medical device R&D supply chain as a Contract Research Organization (CRO). It provides outsourced clinical development services, laboratory testing, and regulatory support, enabling pharmaceutical and device companies to outsource critical stages of drug and device development. The company also engages in equity investments in early-stage biotech and device firms, supporting innovation upstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes expanding integrated, end-to-end clinical development services with digital and decentralized trial technologies to improve efficiency and quality. It emphasizes global expansion, especially in North America and Europe, through organic growth and acquisitions. R&D initiatives focus on developing digital platforms for clinical trial management, risk-based quality management systems, and digital health solutions. The company also invests in early-stage biotech and device companies to foster innovation and build a comprehensive service ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through fee-for-service contracts with pharmaceutical and medical device companies. The company employs two main billing models: fee-for-service (FFS) based on specific deliverables and full-time equivalent (FTE) billing based on dedicated project staff. Income streams include clinical trial technical services, clinical trial related services, laboratory testing services, and consulting. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings in biotech and device firms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tigermed is a leading CRO in China and ranks among the top global CROs. It competes with multinational CROs and domestic mid-sized and small CROs. The company holds the largest market share in China’s clinical outsourcing market and is the only Chinese CRO ranked in the global top ten. Its competitive advantages include extensive clinical trial experience, global synchronized operations, integrated service platforms, high-quality standards, and a broad network of clinical research centers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Tigermed reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.38 billion, representing a 4.21% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 2.02 billion, a slight increase of 0.91%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 29.68 billion, growing 8.14% from the previous year. It employs nearly 9,701 staff globally, with over 1,600 overseas employees. Despite macroeconomic and industry challenges, the company maintained steady growth and expanded its global footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tigermed differentiates itself by offering comprehensive, integrated clinical development services covering the entire drug and device lifecycle, supported by advanced digital and decentralized trial technologies. Its global synchronized operational capabilities and extensive clinical network enable efficient, high-quality project delivery worldwide. The company’s strong quality management system, innovative digital platforms, and strategic investments in biotech startups enhance its ability to reduce R&D risks and costs for clients, accelerating product commercialization and patient access to innovative therapies.
